exposure: newborn brown and black race/skin color
Apgar score <7 in the fifth minute
cohort: The study analyzed all child deaths reported to the Brazilian Mortality Information System in Vitoria de Santo Antao, Pernambuco, Brazil, between 2011 and 2018, specifically focusing on neonatal deaths.
finding: The determinants associated with neonatal death included brown and black race/skin color, prematurity, Apgar score <7 in the 5th minute, and being born in the municipality itself, while caesarean delivery was associated with a lower prevalence of neonatal death.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a lower prevalence of neonatal death (PR 0.83; 95% CI 0.75-0.92).
